phrase: I have read the AnimusDB CLA and I hereby sign it.
_exempt: GitHub logins that never need to sign: the Licensor's own accounts. Bot accounts (login ending in [bot]) are always exempt.
_assistantEmails: Commit author e-mails of coding assistants. Their commits are made on behalf of the pull request's author, whose signature covers them; the e-mail is matched rather than the GitHub login, because noreply@anthropic.com resolves to an unrelated personal account named 'claude'.
